Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the call yesterday — attached is Contoso's standard PO template (PO #4321). Before I send to our AP team I need confirmation on two items so our finance team can map the invoice correctly:

1) Who will issue the invoice to Contoso — Redwood directly or Microsoft (marketplace billing)?
2) If invoicing via Microsoft, can Redwood still receive the customer-facing purchase order and confirm co-sell revenue split for our records? Also please confirm Redwood's remit & tax info to include on the PO (TIN / W-9).

We'd like to get the PO out by end of next week if possible.

Attached: Contoso_PO_4321.pdf

Thanks,
Maria

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@contoso.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-15T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace private engagement - PO and co-sell terms

Hi Maria — thanks for sending this over and for the clear timeline. A few quick answers and next steps below.

1) Invoice path: We can accept either (A) Redwood invoices Contoso directly, or (B) Contoso is billed through Microsoft marketplace if you purchase via a private offer. Option B is our preferred flow for private-plan Marketplace purchases because it clears the marketplace purchase record and enables co-sell reporting.

2) Revenue split & visibility: When transacted via the marketplace private offer, Microsoft will report the transaction to both parties for co-sell reporting. Redwood will still receive the PO and can reconcile revenue split in our internal records; however, the marketplace invoice will appear under Microsoft’s billing.

Action items I propose:
- I will attach an updated SOW (Redwood_SOW_v1.2.pdf) that reflects the agreed-upon seat counts and support SLA (SLA: 99.9% uptime, standard priority escalation).
- Jonas (partnerships) will coordinate with the Azure Marketplace PM to confirm private-offer creation and partner center listing ID.
- Laura (legal) will send a redline for the commercial terms and any required indemnity/data handling language.

Please confirm which invoicing path Contoso prefers (Redwood invoice or Microsoft marketplace invoice) so we can finalize the PO fields.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0192
---
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@contoso.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Azure Marketplace PM <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>
Date: 2026-10-16T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace private engagement - PO and co-sell terms

Hi all — looping in the Marketplace PM to flag the private-offer flow. A couple of operational notes that help avoid rework: 

- Private offer creation: Contoso should confirm they want the private offer established under the Contoso tenant. MS will create the private plan once we send the finalized offer metadata (list price, term, partner share).
- Partner revenue split: For co-sell, Microsoft needs visibility into partner share. Typical split for this engagement is 90/10 (Contoso receives license, Redwood gets partner share). We'll confirm exact partner share in the private-offer metadata.
- Invoice remit: If Contoso wants Microsoft to bill, MS Marketplace issues the invoice to Contoso and pays Redwood per the marketplace payout schedule. Redwood can still send a copy of the PO and reconciliations to Contoso for procurement records.

I've attached our suggested redlines focusing on the licensing clause and the marketplace invoice path (Redwood_Azure_Marketplace_Redlines.docx). Please review and let us know if MS legal needs additional edits.

Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
---
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@contoso.com>, msft-legal@microsoft.com
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-19T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace private engagement - PO and co-sell terms (redlines)

Hi Maria / MS Legal — attaching our redlined commercial terms and an edited SLA excerpt. High-level items we need agreement on before signature: 

1) Indemnity & data handling — we asked to limit Redwood's indemnity to third-party IP claims arising from our deliverables; no open-ended indemnity for customer data processed via the marketplace slot.
2) Audit logs & data residency — for Contoso's compliance we need confirmation that audit logs will be retained for 12 months and accessible on request; if the private offer runs in an Azure region with different residency, please confirm location.
3) Marketplace invoice disambiguation — if MS invoices Contoso, please add an explicit statement that Redwood will be paid per the partner payout schedule and will provide invoice copies for Contoso reconciliation.
4) SLA credits — propose cap at 10% of monthly fees for severe SLA breaches; include a 30‑day cure period.

Attached: Redwood_Azure_Marketplace_Redlines.docx

If MS legal can confirm language on points 2 and 3 we can accept the PO template and proceed to DocuSign.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@contoso.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Azure Marketplace PM <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>, msft-legal@microsoft.com
Date: 2026-10-20T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace private engagement - PO and co-sell terms (final)

Stephanie / Laura — thanks for the quick turn. Contoso is willing to proceed under the Microsoft marketplace private offer flow provided three items are in place:

1) Contoso will be billed via Microsoft marketplace (so MS invoice path is confirmed).
2) Redwood will receive a copy of the PO and monthly reconciliations for co-sell reporting.
3) Audit log retention for 12 months is acceptable — please confirm the Azure region (we prefer US-East).

If MS legal confirms the marketplace invoice wording and region, Contoso procurement will issue PO #4321 today and sign via DocuSign. Please send the final DocuSign link and the marketplace offer ID so we can complete procurement and verify internal approvals.

I'll await the DocuSign link.

Best,
Maria
Sourcing Manager, Contoso
